summary: Gain Therapeutics filed an Item 8.01 8-K on October 1, 2026, disclosing a poster presentation at the International Congress of Parkinson's Disease and Movement Disorders (Seoul, October 4-8, 2026). The poster reports long-term open-label extension data from the Phase 1b study of rexaceract, showing stable MDS-UPDRS Parts II and III scores over 360 days in 12 evaluable patients, versus an accepted ~6-point annual progression benchmark. The company plans to submit a Phase 2 protocol to the FDA in coming weeks and start Phase 2 in Q1 2027. This is a routine clinical/regulatory update, not a special situation.
